title: The Echoing Voice
text: A voice from below calls a Scion's name, rising out of a hole in the ground, in the Lost one's voice. It begs for help. It is almost right: the words are a little too careful, the pauses a little too long, as if someone is learning how to sound like them.

options.label: The steadiest mind answers the voice.

outcomes.text: Not them. A mimic, learning. But it knows where they are, and says so, to keep you talking.
It is not them. It never was. It is very glad you came.

options.label: Roll a stone over the hole.

outcomes.text: It keeps calling, muffled, in their voice. You keep walking.
